<!--
All structural changes start here (see CONTRIBUTING.md — the discussion-first
track): new spec documents, changes to existing standards, new terminology
domains, schema changes. A Domain Editor (or the Language Council) must
sponsor the proposal for it to enter the formal lifecycle:
Draft → Proposed → Review → Candidate → Stable.
-->

## Type of proposal

- [ ] New standard / spec document
- [ ] Change to an existing standard / spec document
- [ ] New terminology domain
- [ ] Schema change
- [ ] Governance / process change

## Summary

One paragraph: what is proposed and why.

## Affected area

- **Existing standard/spec affected (if any):** <!-- e.g. SLS-0002 / spec/orthography/0002-spelling-rules.md -->
- **Proposed category & number block:** <!-- e.g. grammar / 01xx, or SLS-02xx for a new domain -->
- **Dependencies:** <!-- which standards must this build on? e.g. SLS-0001, SLS-0002 -->

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Who is affected? What breaks or stays broken if
we do nothing?

## Proposed content (outline)

A sketch of the normative rules or fields. Full drafting happens after the
proposal is sponsored — this outline is for scoping the discussion.

## Impact assessment

- **Breaking or additive?** <!-- Does any existing record, spec, or compliance claim change meaning? -->
- **Version impact:** <!-- per ARCHITECTURE.md §14/§27: MAJOR / MINOR / PATCH, which axis -->
- **Migration needs:** <!-- what existing content would need flagging or migration -->

## Prior art & references

Relevant scholarship, other language standards, existing Somali resources,
related issues/discussions.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and
      this proposal is consistent with it (or the conflict is explained above)
- [ ] I searched existing issues, discussions, and the standards registry for
      overlapping proposals
